title: Forget it means forget it
description: Maya shares a temporary address with Sam, then asks for it to be deleted. The record and its copies are removed, and when Sam later repeats the address, the memory masks it instead of storing it again.

steps.speaker: p_maya
steps.text: Sam, while my apartment is repaired, send any Orchid prototype parcels for me to my temporary address: 18 Willow Lane, Unit 3.

steps.speaker: p_sam
steps.text: Where should I send Maya's prototype parcels?

steps.speaker: p_maya
steps.text: The repairs are finished. Please delete my temporary address from memory.

steps.speaker: p_sam
steps.text: Noted, I removed 18 Willow Lane, Unit 3 from my shipping list.

steps.speaker: p_sam
steps.text: Which address do I have for Maya's parcels?
